messages:
Jules (Product): hi team — i need to share that i'm resigning effective two weeks from today due to a family bereavement. last day will be 2024-10-05. i want to coordinate benefits/COBRA, laptop return, and staggered access removal if possible. TL;DR: need coverage for my nightly on-call shift, final payroll/pTO questions, and clarity on health benefits end date.

Priya (People Ops): i'm really sorry to hear that, Jules. we can help make this as low friction as possible. i'll list next steps and who to loop: benefits enrollment/COBRA timing (Benefits (HR)), laptop / asset logistics and shipping label (IT-Bot), access deprovision windows and token rotation (Security (SRE)), and on-call coverage plan (Noah).

Noah (Eng Manager): Jules — sending hugs. for on-call: can you drop a short handover doc with the top 5 runbooks and the last two incident links? i can move you out of the rotation starting 2024-10-06, but we need 1 week of overlap pairing. can you do pairing sessions with Lina and Marco next Tue/Wed nights?

Jules (Product): yes — i'll write a 1-pager and add runbook links. pairing: tuesday 10/01 22:00-23:30 PT with Lina and weds 10/02 22:00-23:30 PT with Marco works. also: can we keep calendar forwarding to my manager for 60 days and keep my slack account active for short message forwarding for two weeks after last day?

Priya (People Ops): calendar forwarding is fine — we can set auto-forward for invites to Noah for 60 days. slack forwarding is more sensitive; we usually deprovision slack on last day but we can set a 48-hour grace window for message exports and set up an auto-reply that points people to Noah. would you prefer that?

Jules (Product): 48h grace + auto-reply is perfect.

Benefits (HR): hi @Jules — condolences. health benefits generally terminate at the end of the month of termination unless there's a different contractual clause. since your last day is 2024-10-05, your employer-covered benefits will run through 2024-10-31. COBRA election window: you will receive the COBRA packet within ~7 business days after termination and then have 60 days to elect. COBRA coverage (if elected) is retroactive to 2024-10-06 (the day after termination). we'll email the packet to your personal email on file.

Jules (Product): thanks. can you confirm if HSA contributions stop the paycheck immediately or at month end? also any paperwork i need to sign?

Benefits (HR): HSA employer contributions stop on the payroll that covers 2024-10-05 — so last employer contribution will appear on the paycheck covering that pay period. payroll will calculate final proration and PTO payout; People Ops will confirm amounts and timing. you'll get the COBRA packet + a final benefits summary.

Priya (People Ops): payroll notes: final pay + accrued PTO payout will be processed on the next regular pay cycle (2024-10-15 payroll run). if you have expense reimbursements, please submit by 2024-10-02 for timely processing. i'll email a checklist and a consent form for final tax withholding if needed.

IT-Bot: auto: asset-return request created for Jules. Laptop model: MacBook Pro 14". Return options: drop at office (SF HQ) by 2024-10-07 OR request prepaid shipping label (allow 5 business days). select preference here: https://redwood.intra/assets/returns/form?user=jules

Jules (Product): i'll take the prepaid shipping label. please add a backup spare charger — it's in the bag. also need to export my personal notes from Slack before deprovision.

Security (SRE): quick items: 1) we will rotate any personal API keys and team tokens you're the last editor of on 2024-10-06 03:00 UTC. 2) please list any external vendor logins you maintain (e.g., retrospective services) in the handover doc. 3) if you need a delayed deprovision for specific services, we can schedule individual exemptions for up to 72 hours with audit logging. example deprovision command we will run (internal):
```
# deprovision user
cd /ops/deprovision
./deprovision-user --user jules --slack-delay 48h --tokens-rotate --assets-collect
```

Noah (Eng Manager): thanks Security. for pairing schedule i added Lina/Marco to those slots. Jules — can you add the P0 incident triage steps in the doc and the two last runbook links? once that's in place i'll mark you as paired and remove you from rotation after 10/06 00:00 PT.

Jules (Product): done — doc link: https://docs.redwood.com/handoffs/jules-exit-handover-2024-10-05. includes runbooks, two recent incident links, and vendor login list (masked).

Priya (People Ops): i'll send the exit interview scheduler — we offer an optional 30-min interview on your last day or a later date. also confirming we'll keep your calendar forwarding for 60 days and slack 48h grace + auto-reply. final checklist i'll email now: asset return label, payroll schedule, COBRA packet timing, exit interview link, and IT deprovision times.

Jules (Product): thank you all. appreciate the support.

IT-Bot: auto: prepaid shipping label emailed to jules.personal@example.com (tracking: ZY123456789). Return ETA window: ship within 5 business days.

Benefits (HR): note for record: COBRA packet mailed/emailed 2024-10-08.

Security (SRE): scheduled token rotation and deprovision run booked: 2024-10-06 03:00 UTC. audit logs will be attached to the HR case.

Priya (People Ops): closing loop — i updated Jira HR-1298 with links to the handover doc, asset return tracking, payroll note, and COBRA confirmation. if anything else comes up, DM me. :handshake:
